sources.title: CiE 2026 — Universität Trier
sources.claim: CiE 2026 runs July 27–31, 2026 at Trier University Campus I; co-chairs Henning Fernau and Vasco Brattka; co-located with MCU, CCA, GSW; full registration €200 before July 1.

sources.title: MCU 2026 — Universität Trier
sources.claim: MCU 2026 is July 27–29, 2026 in Trier; co-located with CiE 2026.

sources.title: CCA 2026
sources.claim: CCA 2026 is held July 29–31, 2026 in Trier as a satellite event of CiE 2026.

sources.title: Grammar Systems Workshop 2026 — Universität Trier
sources.claim: GSW 2026 is co-located in Trier with CiE 2026, MCU 2026, and CCA 2026.

sources.title: IRDT Conference 2026
sources.claim: IRDT Conference 2026 runs September 10–11, 2026 at Trier University Campus II.

sources.title: MITL — Medien- und IT-Netzwerk Trier-Luxemburg
sources.claim: MITL holds 'Juni MEETL mit Career Beer' on June 10, 2026 at Bitburger Wirtshaus in Trier.

sources.title: TCDH Events — Trier Center for Digital Humanities
sources.claim: TCDH holds a Grande Région DH symposium on June 11–12, 2026, plus colloquium lectures June 11, June 25, and July 2, 2026.

sources.title: vocatium Trier 2026 — Hochschule Trier
sources.claim: vocatium Trier 2026 runs June 16–17, 2026 at Europahalle Trier; Hochschule Trier Informatik exhibits.

sources.title: Termine und Vorträge — Hochschule Trier Informatik
sources.claim: World Robot Olympiad (WRO) Germany finals 2026 take place June 19–20, 2026 with Hochschule Trier Informatik participation.

sources.title: Wirtschaftskreis Bernkastel-Wittlich events
sources.claim: Westnetz Umspannwerk Laufeld tour on June 2, 2026 at 16:45.

sources.title: Tri-Lux BarCamp (TriLuxCamp)
sources.claim: Tri-Lux BarCamp recurring Trier–Luxembourg unconference; venue Campus Handwerkskammer Trier, Loebstraße 18; no 2026 date announced as of May 2026.

sources.title: IHK Trier Weiterbildung — Digitalisierung & Innovation
sources.claim: IHK Trier offers KI Manager (Aug 17–Nov 26, 2026), Digitalisierungsmanager (Sep 15–Dec 1, 2026), and KI-Online-Sprints as live-online seminars.

sources.title: ILLC listing of CiE 2026
